sn35.241:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre || || 2
sn35.241:1.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā mahantaṃ dārukkhandham Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ ||
sn35.241:1.4: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amum mahantaṃ dārukkhandham Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānanti || ||
sn35.241:1.6: Sace kho bhikkhave dārukkhandho na orimantīraṃ upagacchati na pārimantīram upagacchati || na majjhe saṃsīdissati || na thale ussīdissati || na manussagāho bhavissati || na amanussagāho bhavissati || na āvaṭṭagāho bhavissati || na antopūti bhavissati ||
sn35.241:1.7: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave dārukkhandho samuddaninno bhavissati samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro ||
sn35.241:1.9: samuddaninno bhikkhave Gaṅgāya nadiyā soto samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro || ||
sn35.241:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave sace tumhe pi na orimantīram upagacchatha || na pārimantīram upagacchatha ||
sn35.241:2.2: na majjhe saṃsīdissatha || na thale ussīdissatha || na manussagāho hessatha || na amanussagāho hessatha || na āvaṭṭagāho hessatha || na antopūti bhavissatha ||
sn35.241:2.3: evaṃ tumhe bhikkhave nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā || ||
sn35.241:2.5: nibbānaninnā bhikkhave sammādiṭṭhi nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā ti || || 4
sn35.241:2.6: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.241:2.7: Kiṃ nu kho bhante orimantīram || Kim pārimantīraṃ || Ko majjhe saṃsīdo || Ko thale ussādo || Ko manussagāho || Ko amanussagāho || Ko āvaṭṭagāho || Ko antopūtibhavo ti || || 5
sn35.241:3.1: Orimantīran ti kho bhikkhu channetam ajjhattikānam āyatanānam adhivacanaṃ || || 6
sn35.241:3.2: Pārimantīran ti kho bhikkhu channaṃ bāhirānam āyatanānam adhivacanaṃ || || 7
sn35.241:3.3: Majjhe saṃsīdo ti kho bhikkhu nandirāgassetam adhivacanaṃ || || 8
sn35.241:3.4: Thale ussādo ti kho bhikkhu asmimānassetam adhivacanaṃ || || 9
sn35.241:4.2: Idha bhikkhu gihī saṃsaṭṭho viharati || sahanandi sahasokī sukhitesu sukhito dukkhitesu dukkhito uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogam āpajjati ||
sn35.241:5.2: Idha bhikkhu ekacco ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyam paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati || imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā ti ||
sn35.241:5.4: ti kho bhikkhu pañcannetam kāmaguṇānam adhivacanaṃ || || 12
sn35.241:6.2: Idha bhikkhu ekacco dussīlo hoti || pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭichannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto ||
sn35.241:7.1: Tena kho pana samayena Nando gopālako Bhagavato avidūre ṭhito hoti || || 12
sn35.241:7.2: Atha kho Nando gopālako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.241:7.3: Ahaṃ kho bhante orimantīram upagacchāmi || na pārimantīram upagacchāmi || na majjhe saṃsīdissāmi || na thale ussīdissāmi || na maṃ manussagāho gahissati || na amanussagāho gahissati || na āvaṭṭagāho gahissati || na antopūti bhavissāmi ||
sn35.241:7.4: labheyyāham bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyam upasampadan ti || || 13
sn35.241:7.5: Tena hi tvaṃ Nanda sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādehīti || ||
sn35.241:7.7: Niyyādeheva tvaṃ Nanda sāmikānaṃ gāvo ti || || 14
sn35.241:7.8: Atha kho Nando gopālako sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.241:7.10: labheyyāham bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyam upasampadan ti || || 15
sn35.241:7.11: Alattha kho Nando gopālako Bhagavato santike pabbajjam alattha upasampadaṃ ||
sn35.241:7.12: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā Nando eko vūpakaṭṭho || pe || || 16
sn35.241:7.13: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Nando arahaṃ ahosi || || 1 Evam me
